summary: US military strikes hit multiple Iranian targets including sites near Bandar Abbas, Semnan airport, and Qeshm Island, prompting Iranian missile launches from Bidganeh and Shiraz and an attack on the Crown Plaza hotel in Duqm, Oman housing US forces. Iranian military threatened to open new confrontation fronts if attacks continue, while Kuwait reported defending against Iranian drone attacks. The Strait of Hormuz showed reduced tanker traffic with only two vessels observed.
key_points: US missiles struck sites near Bandar Abbas, Iran, per Fars news agency. (Source: @N12chat/217764)
Explosions reported in Chabahar, Konarak, Ahvaz, and Kharg Island in southern Iran. (Source: @inon_yttach/9492)
US military attacked Semnan airport in northern Iran, which hosts a large IRGC missile base. (Source: @asafroz/51509)
Iran launched missiles from Bidganeh and Shiraz; projectiles hit Dizel Suza area on Qeshm Island causing structural shaking. (Source: @mamlekate/103904)
Satellite images indicate Iran attacked the Crown Plaza hotel in Duqm, Oman, where US forces are stationed. (Source: @kianmeli1/89219)
Kuwaiti military announced it is confronting a drone attack originating from Iran. (Source: @asafroz/51520)
Satellite imagery shows a Patriot missile launch platform in Erbil, Iraq was hit following an Iranian attack. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/377934)
Iranian Army warned that any further hostile action will lead to opening additional confrontation fronts. (Source: @inon_yttach/9495)

sections.executive_summary: US military strikes targeted multiple Iranian locations including Bandar Abbas, Semnan airport, and Qeshm Island, marking a significant escalation in direct kinetic action. Iran responded with missile launches from Bidganeh and Shiraz, struck a US-linked hotel in Duqm, Oman, and threatened to open new fronts regionally. Regional actors including Kuwait and Bahrain implemented defensive measures while Persian Gulf shipping lanes showed unusual emptiness.

points: US missiles struck sites near Bandar Abbas in southern Iran, with additional explosions reported in Chabahar, Konarak, Ahvaz, and the Kharg Island oil terminal, indicating a broad targeting pattern across Iranian coastal and energy infrastructure. (Source: @N12chat/217764, @inon_yttach/9492)

The US military attacked Semnan airport in northern Iran, which hosts a major IRGC missile base, according to Iranian reports citing a large missile installation in the Semnan area. (Source: @asafroz/51509)

Iranian air defenses activated across Tehran, Parchin, Urmia, and Tabriz between 03:50-03:56 local time, with residents reporting repeated explosion sounds, fighter jet noises, and missile launches from Tabriz and Asko in East Azerbaijan. (Source: @VahidOnline/77139, @VahidOnline/77137)

Iran launched missiles from the Bidganeh site at 00:35 and from Shiraz at 00:15 on 25 Tir, with projectiles hitting the Dizel Suza area on Qeshm Island causing houses to shake, and an impact reported in Ahvaz at 01:14. (Source: @mamlekate/103904)

Iranian military leadership threatened to open new confrontation fronts if hostile actions continue, stating responses will exceed enemy expectations and create new arenas of conflict. (Source: @inon_yttach/9495, @almogboker78/17725)

Former US President Trump claimed IRGC capabilities have degraded severely: weapons down 91%, drone capability severely reduced, production capacity reduced, rocket/missile launchers and missiles severely reduced. (Source: @VahidOnline/77142)
Iran's UN ambassador in Geneva warned the UN Human Rights Commissioner about humanitarian consequences of continued US aggression against Iran. (Source: @presstv/199028)
Israeli forces conducted strikes targeting areas across Zawtar Al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, according to Press TV. (Source: @presstv/199018)
The 869th Divisional Collection Battalion identified three armed Hezbollah militants in Beit Yahoun within the security zone, and the 401st Brigade forces eliminated them. (Source: @inon_yttach/9488)
An Israeli-funded campaign aimed at derailing Iran-US negotiations was criticized by US Vice President JD Vance, who stated he represents Americans first. (Source: @presstv/199025)
Morocco officially joined the international stabilization force slated to operate in the Gaza Strip, as announced by the Peace Council. (Source: @almogboker78/17728)
